name: clear bone broth
long_description: A clear golden stock carries tiny beads of marrow fat across its surface.
taste: It tastes cleanly meaty, salty, and gently gelatinous.
smell: Its aroma is warm bone, marrow, and steam.

name: roasted bone stock
long_description: Deep brown stock shows the colour of bones browned before their long simmer.
taste: Roast savour and marrow richness finish faintly smoky.
smell: It smells of browned bones and hearth smoke.

name: beef cooking stock
long_description: A robust brown stock gleams with dissolved juices and sparse golden fat.
taste: It tastes deeply beefy with pepper and clean salt.
smell: Roasted beef and warm onion scent the liquor.

name: mutton cooking stock
long_description: Amber mutton stock bears round droplets of pale sheep fat on top.
taste: It is pastoral, savoury, and distinctly rich.
smell: The steam carries mutton fat and mild herbs.

name: pork cooking stock
long_description: This pale stock has a soft haze and a sweet aroma from simmered pork.
taste: Gentle meat sweetness meets salt and rendered fat.
smell: It smells of pork, softened onion, and steam.

name: fowl cooking stock
long_description: A bright gold stock holds minute droplets of poultry fat and herb flecks.
taste: The flavour is light, savoury, and softly fatty.
smell: Cooked fowl and garden herbs rise in its steam.

name: game cooking stock
long_description: Wild meat and bones give this clear stock a dark amber-brown hue.
taste: It tastes gamey, mineral, and warmly aromatic.
smell: The scent recalls roast game and woodland herbs.

name: fish cooking stock
long_description: A nearly clear fish stock shows a pearly sheen and tiny herb fragments.
taste: Delicate brine and fish sweetness end cleanly.
smell: It smells lightly marine, herbal, and fresh.

name: shellfish cooking stock
long_description: Shells have coloured this translucent stock a warm peach-gold.
taste: It tastes sweetly briny with a mineral finish.
smell: The aroma suggests warm shells and clean sea air.

name: mushroom cooking stock
long_description: A clear brown liquor holds the concentrated colour of simmered mushrooms.
taste: Woodsy savour gives way to pepper and herbs.
smell: It smells earthy, damp, and gently roasted.

name: root vegetable stock
long_description: Mixed roots lend a translucent golden colour and mild natural sweetness.
taste: It tastes earthy, sweet, and lightly salted.
smell: Warm roots and green herbs scent the steam.

name: green vegetable stock
long_description: Leafy trimmings tint this clear vegetable stock a subdued green.
taste: It tastes fresh, mineral, and faintly bitter.
smell: The aroma is leafy, clean, and herbaceous.

name: onion cooking stock
long_description: Long-simmered onions leave this strained liquor clear and warm amber.
taste: Deep allium sweetness balances a savoury saltiness.
smell: It smells of softened onions and gentle caramel.

name: garlic cooking broth
long_description: Crushed garlic gives this clear broth a slight ivory cloudiness.
taste: It tastes warmly pungent, savoury, and clean.
smell: Soft garlic and herbs dominate its aroma.

name: fresh herb broth
long_description: Chopped leaves drift through clear stock tinted faintly green.
taste: Fresh aromatics lead over restrained savour and salt.
smell: It smells grassy, leafy, and newly crushed.

name: grain cooking broth
long_description: Starch from boiled grain gives this broth a cloudy beige body.
taste: It tastes mild, cereal-sweet, and gently savoury.
smell: Warm grain and faint malt scent the liquid.

name: pulse cooking broth
long_description: Cooked pulses leave this strained broth tan and softly opaque.
taste: It tastes earthy, starchy, and modestly salted.
smell: The smell is nutty, warm, and bean-like.

name: spiced meat broth
long_description: Ground and whole spices perfume a brown stock with a glossy surface.
taste: Warm spice unfolds over concentrated meat savour.
smell: It smells peppery, meaty, and richly aromatic.

name: sour herb broth
long_description: A tarting ingredient brightens this clear broth scattered with fresh herbs.
taste: Clean acidity wakes a leafy, lightly savoury base.
smell: It smells sharp, herbal, and appetisingly fresh.

name: marrow-rich broth
long_description: Dissolved marrow lends this broth a pearly haze and generous golden beads.
taste: It tastes buttery, beef-rich, and deeply gelatinous.
smell: Warm marrow and roast bone fill the aroma.

name: cultured cow dairy drink
long_description: A smooth white cultured drink clings lightly to the sides of its vessel.
taste: It tastes creamy, cleanly sour, and refreshing.
smell: The aroma is lactic, cool, and faintly grassy.

name: cultured sheep dairy drink
long_description: Sheep dairy makes this cultured drink ivory, dense, and faintly glossy.
taste: Rich milk sweetness meets an assertive tartness.
smell: It smells creamy, pastoral, and pleasantly sour.

name: cultured goat dairy drink
long_description: This pale cultured dairy drink has a light body and lively sour aroma.
taste: It tastes tangy, mineral, and distinctly goaty.
smell: The scent is sharp dairy with a grassy note.

name: thinned yoghurt drink
long_description: Water and salt loosen yoghurt into a smooth, cooling white drink.
taste: It tastes tart, lightly salty, and very refreshing.
smell: Cultured milk gives it a clean sour fragrance.

name: herbed yoghurt drink
long_description: Fine green herbs remain suspended through this pale cultured drink.
taste: Fresh leaves brighten its creamy, salty tang.
smell: It smells of yoghurt and newly chopped herbs.

name: honeyed cultured dairy
long_description: Honey lends an ivory cultured dairy drink a faint amber sheen.
taste: Floral sweetness softens the clean lactic sourness.
smell: It smells creamy, honeyed, and gently fermented.

name: spiced cultured dairy
long_description: Warm spice flecks show against the pale body of cultured dairy.
taste: Aromatic heat follows its cooling creamy tang.
smell: The fragrance combines sour milk and ground spice.

name: sweet whey drink
long_description: Fresh whey appears translucent yellow with a very light dairy body.
taste: It tastes gently sweet, tart, and faintly milky.
smell: The smell is clean whey and fresh curd.

name: soured whey drink
long_description: Fermentation clouds this whey slightly and gives it a sharper aroma.
taste: It tastes briskly sour with a mineral dairy finish.
smell: It smells lactic, yeasty, and lightly cheesy.

name: buttermilk table drink
long_description: Butter-making leaves this pale drink thin, cloudy, and lightly flecked.
taste: It tastes refreshing, tart, and softly buttery.
smell: The aroma is cultured cream and fresh churn.

name: pressed apple must
long_description: Fresh pressing leaves this apple liquid cloudy gold with fine fruit sediment.
taste: It tastes crisp, tart, and naturally sweet.
smell: Raw apple and crushed peel scent the must.

name: pressed pear must
long_description: This pale fruit must has a soft haze and delicate floral perfume.
taste: It tastes mellow, juicy, and honey-sweet.
smell: Ripe pear and fresh-cut flesh shape the aroma.

name: pressed grape must
long_description: Skins tint this freshly pressed grape must a vivid translucent purple-red.
taste: It tastes winey, sweet, and lightly tannic.
smell: Crushed grapes give it a lush fruity fragrance.

name: mixed berry pressing
long_description: Tiny seeds and pulp cloud this dark crimson pressed berry liquid.
taste: It tastes sharply fruity with concentrated sweetness.
smell: The smell is vivid berries and crushed leaves.

name: pressed plum drink
long_description: Soft plum pulp gives the pressed drink a rich ruby-purple haze.
taste: It tastes sweet-sour, winey, and full-bodied.
smell: Ripe plum skins lend a dark fruity aroma.

name: fig-steeped fruit drink
long_description: Steeped figs tint the water amber and leave tiny seeds suspended.
taste: It tastes earthy, honeyed, and softly fruity.
smell: The aroma is dried fig and warm sweetness.

name: date-steeped fruit drink
long_description: Soft dates lend this strained drink a clear brown-gold colour.
taste: Caramel sweetness follows a faint earthy note.
smell: It smells of ripe dates and dark syrup.

name: melon water drink
long_description: Crushed melon flesh makes this drink pale green and softly cloudy.
taste: It tastes cooling, watery, and delicately sweet.
smell: Fresh melon gives a mild floral fragrance.

name: tart citrus pressing
long_description: Fresh citrus juice shines bright yellow with fine pulp throughout.
taste: It tastes sharply acidic, fragrant, and refreshing.
smell: The scent is vivid peel and fresh-cut citrus.

name: tamarind water drink
long_description: Tamarind pulp clouds this water a warm russet-brown shade.
taste: It tastes fruity, sour, and faintly caramel-like.
smell: The aroma is tart fruit with an earthy sweetness.

name: pressed pineapple drink
long_description: Fibrous pulp clouds this vivid gold pressed tropical fruit liquid.
taste: It tastes piercingly tart, lush, and sweet.
smell: The scent is powerful pineapple and fresh rind.

name: pressed guava drink
long_description: Guava pulp makes this pressed drink cloudy pink and seed-flecked.
taste: It tastes floral, grainy, and sweet-tart.
smell: Ripe guava gives an intense perfumed aroma.

name: barley water drink
long_description: Boiled barley leaves this strained drink pale, cloudy, and softly starchy.
taste: It tastes mildly malty with gentle cereal sweetness.
smell: The smell is warm grain and faint toast.

name: toasted barley drink
long_description: Roasted barley colours this strained drink a clear medium brown.
taste: It tastes nutty, toasted, and slightly bitter.
smell: The aroma suggests malt, biscuit, and roast grain.

name: wheat water drink
long_description: Cooked wheat starch gives this water a cloudy cream appearance.
taste: It tastes softly wheaten, mild, and faintly sweet.
smell: Warm bread grain shapes its gentle aroma.

name: rye water drink
long_description: Dark rye lends this strained grain water a grey-brown hue.
taste: It tastes earthy, sour-tinged, and robust.
smell: The scent is dark bread and damp grain.

name: rice water drink
long_description: Rice starch makes this drink milky white despite its light body.
taste: It tastes clean, soothing, and gently starchy.
smell: Steamed rice gives it a quiet sweet aroma.

name: toasted rice drink
long_description: Toasted rice colours the strained liquor pale gold and clear.
taste: It tastes nutty, light, and delicately scorched.
smell: The fragrance recalls roasted rice and warm straw.

name: millet water drink
long_description: Fine millet particles leave this grain drink soft yellow and hazy.
taste: It tastes grassy, mild, and faintly nutty.
smell: Warm millet gives a dry cereal fragrance.

name: sorghum water drink
long_description: Reddish sorghum meal gives the light drink a russet cloudiness.
taste: It tastes earthy, mineral, and subtly sweet.
smell: The smell is warm sorghum and dry grass.

name: maize water drink
long_description: Fine maize meal remains suspended in this cloudy yellow drink.
taste: It tastes distinctly corny, mild, and sweet.
smell: Fresh meal gives it a warm maize aroma.

name: sprouted grain drink
long_description: Crushed sprouts make this strained grain drink pale and faintly green.
taste: It tastes fresh, grassy, and naturally malty.
smell: The aroma is young grain and damp straw.

name: honeyed grain water
long_description: A little honey gives cloudy grain water an amber surface glint.
taste: It tastes floral, cereal-soft, and gently sweet.
smell: Honey and warm meal mingle in the scent.

name: spiced grain water
long_description: Ground spice flecks remain suspended through a light tan grain drink.
taste: It tastes warm, cereal-like, and gently aromatic.
smell: The fragrance combines grain with crushed spice.

name: juniper-smoked small beer
long_description: Juniper twigs used over the malt fire leave this weak beer pale gold beneath a thin resin-scented haze.
taste: Light cereal sweetness meets dry evergreen bitterness and a restrained smoky close.
smell: Fresh yeast mingles with juniper wood and cool malt.

name: smoked-malt strong beer
long_description: Dark malt dried over a smoky fire gives this strong beer a deep amber body and a persistent cream-coloured head.
taste: Toast and caramel grain lead into woody smoke, firm bitterness, and alcoholic warmth.
smell: The foam smells of browned malt, hearth smoke, and active yeast.

name: wheat beer
long_description: Suspended yeast makes this pale wheat beer opaquely golden.
taste: It tastes soft, bready, and lightly tart.
smell: Fresh dough and fermentation shape its smell.

name: rye beer
long_description: Rye malt gives this beer a dark russet colour and close foam.
taste: It tastes earthy, spicy, and faintly sour.
smell: Dark bread and warm yeast rise together.

name: millet beer
long_description: Fine grain sediment clouds this softly fermenting yellow beer.
taste: It tastes grassy, tart, and mildly yeasty.
smell: The scent is sour grain and dry straw.

name: sorghum beer
long_description: Russet grain sediment gives this sorghum beer a thick red-brown cast.
taste: It tastes earthy, sour, and faintly sweet.
smell: Fermented sorghum lends a robust aroma.

name: maize beer
long_description: A loose layer of foam rests over a cloudy golden fermented maize drink.
taste: It tastes corny, tart, and gently alcoholic.
smell: Sour maize and yeast scent the liquid.

name: rice beer
long_description: Fermented rice leaves this drink pale, milky, and softly effervescent.
taste: It tastes mellow, sour-sweet, and yeasty.
smell: Rice mash and light alcohol shape its aroma.

name: sprouted grain ale
long_description: Mixed sprouted grains give this ale an uneven amber haze.
taste: It tastes malty, grassy, and modestly bitter.
smell: Sprouts, toast, and yeast fill the nose.

name: small grain beer
long_description: This weak pale beer shows little foam and a light grain haze.
taste: It tastes thin, bready, and gently sour.
smell: The smell is mild malt and active yeast.

name: honey ferment
long_description: Fermented honey produces a clear gold drink with sparse rising bubbles.
taste: It tastes floral, dry, and warmly alcoholic.
smell: Honey, wax, and yeast perfume the drink.

name: light honey ferment
long_description: A weak honey ferment shines pale yellow beneath a lively bead of bubbles.
taste: It tastes floral, fresh, and only mildly dry.
smell: Wildflower honey and yeast scent the glass.

name: fruit-honey ferment
long_description: Fruit skins tint this fermented honey drink a clear ruby shade.
taste: It tastes tart, floral, and softly alcoholic.
smell: Ripe fruit and honey mingle in its aroma.

name: spiced honey ferment
long_description: Warm spice flecks deepen the amber colour of fermented honey.
taste: It tastes floral, warming, and richly dry.
smell: Honey and crushed aromatics fill the nose.

name: fermented apple drink
long_description: Fine bubbles travel through a clear gold drink pressed from fermented apples.
taste: It tastes crisp, tart, and lightly tannic.
smell: Apple peel and fermentation scent the drink.

name: fermented pear drink
long_description: This pale gold pear ferment has a delicate haze and lively bubbles.
taste: It tastes floral, dry, and softly sweet.
smell: Ripe pear gives a gentle perfumed smell.

name: fermented plum drink
long_description: Plum skins colour this fermented drink a dark translucent purple-red.
taste: It tastes winey, sour, and fruit-rich.
smell: The aroma is ripe plum and warm alcohol.

name: fermented berry drink
long_description: A crimson fermented berry drink carries seed sediment at the bottom.
taste: It tastes sharply fruity, dry, and tannic.
smell: Wild berries and yeast give a vivid scent.

name: fermented herb drink
long_description: Herbs and fermentation colour this drink a cloudy green-brown.
taste: It tastes sour, grassy, and gently bitter.
smell: The smell is leafy, yeasty, and sharp.

name: fermented bread drink
long_description: Soaked dark bread leaves this weak ferment cloudy brown and lightly foaming.
taste: It tastes sour, toasted, and faintly sweet.
smell: Rye crust and yeast dominate the aroma.

name: raisin-restored grape wine
long_description: Soaked raisins have restored body and sweetness to a pale grape wine, leaving it golden and slightly viscous.
taste: Dried-fruit richness rounds the wine's acidity before a warm honeyed finish.
smell: Raisin, grape skin, and faint fermentation rise from the cup.

name: amber grape wine
long_description: Extended skin contact gives this wine a deep amber colour.
taste: It tastes tannic, dry, and orchard-fruity.
smell: Grape skin and dried flowers shape the nose.

name: pine-resin grape wine
long_description: Pine resin used to seal the wine vessel lends the amber drink a faint haze and an unmistakable woodland perfume.
taste: Dry grape acidity is followed by sharp resin, herbs, and a warming tannic close.
smell: Its aroma combines fermented grapes, pine needles, and fresh-cut wood.

name: rose grape wine
long_description: This clear pink wine carries the colour of briefly steeped grape skins.
taste: It tastes fresh, lightly tannic, and berry-like.
smell: Red fruit and flowers scent the wine.

name: sweet grape wine
long_description: A viscous golden wine moves slowly and shines beneath the light.
taste: It tastes honeyed, fruity, and warmly alcoholic.
smell: Ripe grapes and dried fruit perfume it.

name: dried-grape wine
long_description: Wine from dried grapes appears dark amber with a dense glossy body.
taste: It tastes raisin-rich, sweet, and concentrated.
smell: Dried fruit and warm alcohol fill the nose.

name: spiced grape wine
long_description: Whole spices lend a ruby wine a darker cast and warm perfume.
taste: It tastes fruity, warming, and pepper-fragrant.
smell: Grape, spice, and citrus peel scent it.

name: honeyed grape wine
long_description: Honey softens this amber grape wine and gives it a rounded body.
taste: It tastes floral, winey, and richly sweet.
smell: Honey and ripe grape share the aroma.

name: apple wine
long_description: Fully fermented apple juice produces a clear and warming gold wine.
taste: It tastes dry, tart, and orchard-fragrant.
smell: Mature apple and alcohol scent the glass.

name: pear wine
long_description: A pale wine has been fermented from fragrant ripe pears, retaining slight cloudiness from the fruit.
taste: It tastes dry, floral, and softly rounded.
smell: Pear skin and white flowers mark the nose.

name: plum wine
long_description: A clear ruby-purple wine carries the dark colour of ripe plums.
taste: It tastes sweet-sour, warming, and winey.
smell: Plum skin and stone fruit scent it.

name: pomegranate wine
long_description: A clear crimson wine shows a vivid jewel-like colour in the cup.
taste: It tastes tart, tannic, and fruit-bright.
smell: Pomegranate rind and red fruit perfume it.

name: clear grain spirit
long_description: This colourless spirit catches the light without haze or sediment.
taste: It tastes fiery, dry, and faintly cereal-like.
smell: Hot alcohol carries a whisper of grain.

name: aged grain spirit
long_description: Time in wood gives this strong grain spirit a clear amber hue.
taste: It tastes warming, toasted, and faintly woody.
smell: Alcohol, oak, and grain fill the nose.

name: clear fruit spirit
long_description: A clear strong spirit retains a delicate trace of distilled fruit.
taste: It tastes fiery, dry, and subtly fruity.
smell: Sharp alcohol carries ripe fruit fragrance.

name: grape spirit
long_description: This distilled grape spirit is pale gold and brilliantly clear.
taste: It tastes hot, winey, and softly sweet.
smell: Grape skins and alcohol define the aroma.

name: honey spirit
long_description: A colourless spirit preserves a faint floral character from fermented honey.
taste: It tastes fiery, dry, and delicately floral.
smell: Hot alcohol carries beeswax and flowers.

name: spiced distilled spirit
long_description: Steeped spices tint a powerful distilled spirit clear amber.
taste: It tastes hot, aromatic, and lingeringly warm.
smell: Alcohol and crushed spice dominate the smell.

name: roasted barley infusion
long_description: Roasted barley steeps this clear caffeine-free infusion medium brown.
taste: It tastes nutty, toasted, and gently bitter.
smell: Roast grain and warm biscuit scent it.

name: roasted rice infusion
long_description: Toasted rice gives this clear infusion a pale golden colour.
taste: It tastes light, nutty, and delicately scorched.
smell: The aroma recalls rice and warm straw.

name: fresh leaf infusion
long_description: Fresh edible leaves colour this clear hot infusion a light green.
taste: It tastes grassy, mild, and faintly bitter.
smell: Crushed green leaves shape its fragrance.

name: dried leaf infusion
long_description: Dried leaves release an amber colour and fine sediment while steeping.
taste: It tastes herbal, tannic, and softly dry.
smell: Dried foliage and warm hay scent it.

name: flower infusion
long_description: Steeped petals lend this clear water a delicate blush of colour.
taste: It tastes floral, light, and gently sweet.
smell: Fresh blossoms provide a perfumed aroma.

name: root and spice infusion
long_description: Sliced roots and spice make this hot infusion deep amber.
taste: It tastes earthy, warming, and aromatic.
smell: Root, bark, and spice rise in steam.

name: fruit peel infusion
long_description: Fruit peel colours this clear infusion yellow with tiny oil droplets.
taste: It tastes tart, fragrant, and faintly bitter.
smell: Fresh rind gives a vivid citrus-like scent.

name: honeyed herb infusion
long_description: Honey gives a green-flecked herbal infusion a golden glow.
taste: It tastes floral, leafy, and soothingly sweet.
smell: Honey and fresh herbs scent the steam.

name: light-roast coffee infusion
long_description: A light roasting leaves this coffee infusion clear russet rather than black.
taste: It tastes bright, bitter, and faintly fruity.
smell: Roasted beans give a sharp fragrant aroma.

name: coffee-husk infusion
long_description: Dried coffee-fruit husks tint this clear infusion russet and leave a few curled fragments at the bottom.
taste: It tastes gently tart and raisin-like, with only a distant roasted bitterness.
smell: Dried cherry skin, hay, and warm fruit scent the rising steam.

name: spiced coffee infusion
long_description: Warm spice flecks show against the dark body of brewed coffee.
taste: It tastes bitter, aromatic, and gently hot.
smell: Coffee roast mingles with crushed spice.

name: honeyed coffee infusion
long_description: Honey gives dark coffee a slight amber sheen around the edge.
taste: It tastes bittersweet, floral, and strongly roasted.
smell: Honey softens the powerful coffee fragrance.

name: cacao drink
long_description: Whisking leaves a light foam over this dark water-based cacao drink.
taste: It tastes bitter, earthy, and richly chocolate-like.
smell: Roasted cacao gives a deep warm aroma.

name: spiced cacao drink
long_description: Ground spice remains suspended beneath the foam of dark cacao.
taste: It tastes bitter, warming, and intensely aromatic.
smell: Cacao and spice fill the rising steam.

name: honeyed cacao drink
long_description: Honey softens a dark cacao drink and gives its foam an amber edge.
taste: It tastes bittersweet, floral, and richly chocolate-like.
smell: Honey rounds the roasted cacao fragrance.

name: creamy cacao drink
long_description: Dairy gives this cacao drink a thick, smooth, pale-brown body.
taste: It tastes creamy, bitter, and gently sweet.
smell: Warm milk and roasted cacao scent it.

name: brown meat sauce
long_description: Reduced meat juices form a glossy sauce that clings heavily to food.
taste: It tastes roasted, salty, and deeply savoury.
smell: Browned meat and onion scent it.

name: light fowl sauce
long_description: Fowl stock and fat reduce into a pale gold, spoon-coating sauce.
taste: It tastes delicate, buttery, and herb-savoury.
smell: Poultry, herbs, and warm fat rise gently.

name: fish savour sauce
long_description: Salted fish gives this thin brown cooking sauce a clear appearance.
taste: It tastes intensely briny, fermented, and savoury.
smell: Pungent fish and salt dominate its smell.

name: shellfish reduction
long_description: Shellfish liquor reduces into a glossy peach-brown finishing sauce.
taste: It tastes mineral, sweetly briny, and concentrated.
smell: Warm shells and sea air scent it.

name: mushroom reduction sauce
long_description: Mushroom juices form a dark, silky sauce with fine brown sediment.
taste: It tastes woodsy, peppery, and richly savoury.
smell: Earthy mushrooms give a damp roasted aroma.

name: onion gravy
long_description: Slow-cooked onions thicken this amber gravy into a glossy pour.
taste: It tastes caramel-sweet, savoury, and gently salty.
smell: Soft onions and roast juices scent it.

name: garlic herb sauce
long_description: Crushed garlic and herbs make a pale sauce densely flecked with green.
taste: It tastes pungent, fresh, and warmly savoury.
smell: Garlic and cut leaves fill the aroma.

name: sour herb sauce
long_description: Fresh herbs suspend in a bright sour sauce of clear green-gold.
taste: It tastes tart, leafy, and appetite-waking.
smell: Acid and crushed herbs scent it sharply.

name: yoghurt sauce
long_description: Strained yoghurt makes this white sauce smooth, thick, and cooling.
taste: It tastes creamy, sour, and lightly salted.
smell: Cultured dairy gives a clean tangy smell.

name: melted cheese sauce
long_description: Melted cheese forms a thick golden sauce that stretches when poured.
taste: It tastes salty, creamy, and richly matured.
smell: Warm cheese provides a powerful dairy aroma.

name: ground nut sauce
long_description: Ground nuts give this tan cooking sauce a smooth, oily body.
taste: It tastes toasted, creamy, and softly savoury.
smell: Roasted nuts and spice shape the smell.

name: tart fruit meat sauce
long_description: Reduced tart fruit makes a ruby sauce intended for rich roasted meat.
taste: It tastes sweet-sour, fruity, and warmly spiced.
smell: Cooked fruit and pepper perfume it.

name: hot chile savour sauce
long_description: Crushed chile gives this thin savoury sauce a vivid red colour.
taste: It tastes sharply hot, salty, and fruity.
smell: Fresh pepper and fermentation scent it.

name: savoury cacao sauce
long_description: Cacao and spice make this savoury sauce dark brown and velvety.
taste: It tastes bitter, aromatic, and richly complex.
smell: Roasted cacao and warm spice scent it.

name: walnut cooking oil
long_description: Pressed walnuts produce a clear golden oil with a delicate body.
taste: It tastes nutty, rich, and faintly bitter.
smell: Fresh walnut gives a soft roasted scent.

name: hazelnut cooking oil
long_description: This pale amber oil shines clearly after careful nut pressing.
taste: It tastes toasted, sweet, and deeply nutty.
smell: Roasted hazelnut perfumes the oil.

name: almond cooking oil
long_description: Almond pressing yields a pale gold oil with very little sediment.
taste: It tastes mild, buttery, and softly nutty.
smell: Sweet almond gives a delicate fragrance.

name: poppyseed cooking oil
long_description: Tiny seeds produce a clear yellow oil of light consistency.
taste: It tastes earthy, mild, and pleasantly nutty.
smell: Poppyseed lends a quiet grassy aroma.

name: linseed cooking oil
long_description: Pressed linseed gives this edible oil a deep golden colour.
taste: It tastes grassy, earthy, and slightly bitter.
smell: Seeds and cut grass shape the aroma.

name: hempseed cooking oil
long_description: Hempseed tints this clear cooking oil a muted green-gold.
taste: It tastes grassy, robust, and nut-like.
smell: Crushed seed gives an earthy smell.

name: mustard seed oil
long_description: Mustard seed yields a bright yellow oil with a sharp vapour.
taste: It tastes pungent, hot, and richly oily.
smell: Mustard heat dominates the nose.

name: palm fruit oil
long_description: Palm fruit produces an opaque orange-red oil that sets softly when cool.
taste: It tastes earthy, fruity, and richly fatty.
smell: Warm palm fruit gives a distinctive scent.

name: coconut cooking oil
long_description: This pale oil is clear when warm and firm white when cooled.
taste: It tastes creamy, sweet, and coconut-fragrant.
smell: Fresh coconut gives a tropical aroma.

name: grapeseed cooking oil
long_description: Grape seeds yield a light, clear oil with green-gold highlights.
taste: It tastes mild, dry, and faintly nutty.
smell: Crushed grape seed gives little aroma.

name: dark grain vinegar
long_description: Fermented grain gives this clear vinegar a deep brown colour.
taste: It tastes sharply sour, malty, and robust.
smell: Dark grain and acid fill the nose.

name: pale grain vinegar
long_description: A pale straw vinegar retains only a light tint from fermented grain.
taste: It tastes clean, sour, and faintly cereal-like.
smell: Sharp acid carries a mild grain scent.

name: rice vinegar
long_description: Rice fermentation produces a nearly colourless, softly aromatic vinegar.
taste: It tastes mild, clean, and gently sour.
smell: Soft acid and rice shape the aroma.

name: apple vinegar
long_description: Apple sediment leaves this golden vinegar faintly cloudy.
taste: It tastes fruity, tart, and sharply acidic.
smell: Apple peel rides above the vinegar scent.

name: pear vinegar
long_description: This pale vinegar preserves a delicate perfume from ripe pears.
taste: It tastes floral, sour, and softly fruity.
smell: Pear fragrance tempers the sharp acid smell.

name: plum vinegar
long_description: Plum skins give this clear fruit vinegar a ruby tint.
taste: It tastes winey, sour, and faintly sweet.
smell: Dark fruit mingles with bright acidity.

name: berry vinegar
long_description: A vivid crimson vinegar carries fine sediment from crushed berries.
taste: It tastes sharply fruity and mouth-puckeringly sour.
smell: Berry perfume rises through strong acid.

name: date vinegar
long_description: Dates lend this clear vinegar a dark amber, syrup-like colour.
taste: It tastes caramel-fruity, sour, and rich.
smell: Date sweetness underlies the acid aroma.

name: honey vinegar
long_description: Fermented honey creates a clear gold vinegar with floral traces.
taste: It tastes brightly sour with a delicate sweetness.
smell: Flowers and acid share the fragrance.

name: herbed vinegar
long_description: Steeped herbs tint clear vinegar green and leave small leaf fragments.
taste: It tastes sharp, leafy, and strongly aromatic.
smell: Crushed herbs soften the piercing acid smell.

name: honey dilution syrup
long_description: Honey thinned for pouring forms a clear amber, slow-moving syrup.
taste: It tastes floral, rich, and purely sweet.
smell: Warm honey and beeswax scent it.

name: spiced honey syrup
long_description: Ground spice darkens flowing honey syrup and leaves fine flecks.
taste: It tastes warming, floral, and intensely sweet.
smell: Honey and spice fill the aroma.

name: grape reduction syrup
long_description: Reduced grape must forms a thick, glossy purple-black syrup.
taste: It tastes winey, fruity, and richly sweet.
smell: Cooked grape and caramel scent it.

name: date reduction syrup
long_description: Cooked dates yield a dark brown syrup with a heavy pour.
taste: It tastes caramel-like, earthy, and very sweet.
smell: Ripe date and dark sugar shape the smell.

name: fig reduction syrup
long_description: Fig pulp reduces into a seed-flecked amber-brown syrup.
taste: It tastes jammy, earthy, and honey-sweet.
smell: Cooked fig gives a warm fruity aroma.

name: apple reduction syrup
long_description: Concentrated apple juice forms a clear russet pouring syrup.
taste: It tastes tart, caramelised, and richly fruity.
smell: Cooked apple and browned sugar scent it.

name: berry reduction syrup
long_description: Reduced mixed berry juice makes a glossy deep crimson syrup.
taste: It tastes tart, vivid, and intensely sweet.
smell: Cooked berries give a powerful fruit smell.

name: refined sugar cooking syrup
long_description: Refined sugar dissolved for confectionery makes a clear, heavy syrup.
taste: It tastes cleanly and overwhelmingly sweet.
smell: Hot sugar gives a faint caramel smell.
